points.K1: 脚手架事故的主要原因
points.K7: 高处作业要有坠落防护
points.K8: 安全带不随意挂在架子上
points.S5: 实验室里的移动登高平台
points.S6: 仰头举臂作业防颈肩劳损

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在脚手架前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a safety helmet stands in front of a scaffold and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天用十道题，学学脚手架安全。

shots.scene: 一行图标：脚手架、踏板、护栏、安全带
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a scaffold, a plank, a guardrail and a safety harness. No people.
shots.narration: 踏板、护栏、坠落防护，一个都不能少。

shots.scene: 高大的实验厅里，老李正在搭好的脚手架旁准备安装排风管
shots.prompt_en: In a tall laboratory hall, the facility engineer prepares to install an exhaust duct beside an assembled scaffold.
shots.narration: 高大实验厅要装排风管，搭起了脚手架。

shots.scene: 阿杰踩着交叉支撑往上爬
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts to climb up the cross braces on the side of the scaffold.
shots.narration: 阿杰想帮忙，抬脚就往架子上爬。

shots.scene: 老李急忙拦住他
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer quickly stops the young male student and helps him down.
shots.narration: 老李赶紧把他叫下来。

shots.scene: 欣欣出现，举起题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot appears holding a blank question card.
shots.narration: 上架之前，先答十道题。

shots.section_title: 脚手架事故的主要原因
shots.scene: 脚手架图标，三个红色警示点：踏板、人、护栏
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold icon with three red warning spots: on a plank, on a person icon and on a guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：脚手架事故多由什么引起？
overlay: 脚手架事故的主要原因

shots.section_title: 脚手架事故的主要原因
shots.scene: 踏板翘起滑脱的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a scaffold plank tipping and sliding off its support. No people.
shots.narration: 踏板或支撑滑脱、塌落，

shots.section_title: 脚手架事故的主要原因
shots.scene: 人形图标滑倒，上方一个扳手掉落
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person slipping on a platform while a wrench falls from above. No people.
shots.narration: 人员滑倒，或被上面掉下的东西砸中，

shots.section_title: 脚手架事故的主要原因
shots.scene: 护栏缺了一段的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a scaffold platform with a section of guardrail missing. No people.
shots.narration: 护栏缺失或损坏。

shots.section_title: 脚手架事故的主要原因
shots.scene: 欣欣举起写着三个勾的卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a card with three check marks.
shots.narration: 答案是以上都是，三样都要防。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在架子下，抬头仔细看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands at the base of the scaffold and looks up carefully.
shots.narration: 第二题：上架前检查是谁的责任？

shots.scene: 欣欣指着阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the young male student.
shots.narration: 原题答案是：你自己。

shots.scene: 阿杰查看踏板、护栏、底座
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks the planks, the guardrails and the base plates of the scaffold.
shots.narration: 看踏板、护栏、底座，有疑问就别上。

shots.scene: 老李和搭设人员在架子旁核对检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reviews a blank checklist with a scaffold crew member beside the scaffold.
shots.narration: 搭设和管理方的检查，同样不能少。

shots.scene: 人形图标踩着交叉支撑往上爬，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person climbing on the diagonal cross braces, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：能踩交叉支撑往上爬吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 不能，这句话是错误的。

shots.scene: 交叉支撑受力变形的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cross brace bending under a foot. No people.
shots.narration: 支撑不是梯子，踩上去会变形脱落。

shots.scene: 老李从架子内侧的专用爬梯上去，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer climbs the built-in access ladder of the scaffold; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 上下要走专用爬梯或通道。

shots.scene: 一块断裂的踏板，旁边一块普通木板和一块专用踏板
shots.prompt_en: A cracked scaffold plank, with an ordinary board and a proper scaffold plank beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：踏板坏了用什么换？

shots.scene: 普通木板打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The ordinary board is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 随手找的木板，承重不够。

shots.scene: 专用踏板打勾
shots.prompt_en: The proper scaffold plank gets a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 正确，只能用脚手架专用踏板。

shots.scene: 两块踏板之间有一道缝，小扳手正从缝里掉下
shots.prompt_en: A small wrench falls through a gap between two scaffold planks. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：踏板之间能留多大的缝？

shots.scene: 缝隙缩小，踏板铺满
shots.prompt_en: The gap closes and the planks lie tightly side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 缝要尽量小，防止踩空和落物。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章图标
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体限值按国内规范，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 两块踏板在横杆上重叠搭接
shots.prompt_en: Two scaffold planks overlapping each other over a support bar. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：踏板搭接要不要够长？

shots.scene: 搭接太短的踏板滑落，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a short overlap where one plank slides off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要，太短一踩就会滑脱。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，指着搭接处
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the plank overlap.
shots.narration: 正确，搭接长度按规范来。

shots.section_title: 高处作业要有坠落防护
shots.scene: 高处平台上的人形图标，护栏和安全带同时出现
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person on a high platform protected by a guardrail and wearing a safety harness. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：高处作业要不要坠落防护？
overlay: 高处作业要有坠落防护

shots.section_title: 高处作业要有坠落防护
shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 正确，每个人都要有。

shots.section_title: 高处作业要有坠落防护
shots.scene: 护栏图标和安全带图标并列
shots.prompt_en: A guardrail icon and a safety harness icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 装护栏，或者系好防坠落装备。

shots.section_title: 高处作业要有坠落防护
shots.scene: 高度标尺，国内标准图示
shots.prompt_en: A vertical height ruler next to a platform with a blank sign. No people.
shots.narration: 高处作业的高度界限，按国内标准。

shots.section_title: 安全带不随意挂在架子上
shots.scene: 安全带挂钩挂在脚手架横杆上，打问号
shots.prompt_en: A harness lanyard hook clipped to a scaffold bar with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：安全带能随便挂在架子上吗？
overlay: 安全带不随意挂在架子上

shots.section_title: 安全带不随意挂在架子上
shots.scene: 欣欣摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head.
shots.narration: 不能，这句话是错误的。

shots.section_title: 安全带不随意挂在架子上
shots.scene: 架子一晃，挂点跟着倒的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a scaffold tipping over and the attached lanyard going down with it. No people.
shots.narration: 架子一倒，挂点也跟着倒。

shots.section_title: 安全带不随意挂在架子上
shots.scene: 挂钩挂在独立牢固的锚点上，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The hook is clipped to an independent strong anchor point on the building structure; a green check appears.
shots.narration: 要挂在独立、牢固、经确认的锚点上。

shots.scene: 电线垂到架子边，人形图标被闪电击中
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power line touching the scaffold and a person icon struck by a lightning symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：有人碰到电线触电怎么办？

shots.scene: 徒手拉人的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand grabbing the shocked person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 千万别徒手去拉，自己也会触电。

shots.scene: 电话图标，写着120
shots.prompt_en: A large telephone icon with a medical cross. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答案：拨打急救电话120。

shots.scene: 欣欣举手示意先断电
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a hand and points at a power switch icon.
shots.narration: 同时要设法先切断电源。

shots.scene: 梯子和脚手架并排，两个人形图标都带警示
shots.prompt_en: A ladder and a scaffold side by side, each with a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：梯子摔下来，也那么危险？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods seriously.
shots.narration: 正确，梯子不高也可能致命。

shots.scene: 头部撞地的图标和安全帽图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a head hitting the floor next to a safety helmet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 摔下时头先着地，后果很严重。

shots.scene: 小研扶梯，阿杰站在梯子中段
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a ladder steady while the young male student stands on a middle step.
shots.narration: 用梯子也要有人扶、站得稳。

shots.scene: 脚手架上挂着绿色合格牌
shots.prompt_en: A green inspection tag hangs on the scaffold. No people.
shots.narration: 脚手架搭好后，要先验收合格。

shots.scene: 另一个架子挂着红色禁用牌，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Another scaffold has a red do-not-use tag and is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 挂禁用牌或没挂牌，一律不上。

shots.scene: 搭设人员出示空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: A scaffold crew member shows a blank certificate card to the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 搭设和拆除要由持证人员完成。

shots.scene: 王老师在验收单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank acceptance form beside the scaffold.
shots.narration: 验收后定期检查，改动后重新验收。

shots.scene: 老李系好全身式安全带
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on a full-body safety harness and tightens the straps.
shots.narration: 上高处，系好全身式安全带。

shots.scene: 老李检查织带和挂钩
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects the webbing and the hooks of the harness.
shots.narration: 用前检查织带有无磨损，挂钩是否灵活。

shots.scene: 挂点高于腰部，打勾；挂点低于脚，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A lanyard anchored above the waist with a green check, beside one anchored below the feet with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 挂点要高于腰部，高挂低用。

shots.scene: 阿杰打哈欠、扶额头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student yawns and holds his forehead, looking dizzy.
shots.narration: 头晕、疲劳、没睡好，不要登高。

shots.scene: 药片和酒杯图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of pills and a wine glass crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 饮酒或服了嗜睡药物，不要登高。

shots.scene: 医生在空白体检表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clipboard with a blank health check form and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有恐高、癫痫等禁忌的，不安排登高。

shots.scene: 大风和雷雨的天气图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of strong wind and thunderstorm crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 室外大风雷雨，停止高处作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着配电箱上的总开关
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the main switch on an electrical distribution box.
shots.narration: 发现有人触电，先断开电源。

shots.scene: 用干燥木棍挑开电线的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dry wooden stick pushing a wire away. No people.
shots.narration: 够不到开关，用干燥绝缘物挑开。

shots.scene: 小研拨打电话，老李跑去报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call while the facility engineer runs to report.
shots.narration: 脱离电源后拨打120，报告负责人。

shots.scene: 受过培训的人跪地检查伤员
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator kneels beside an injured person icon to check breathing.
shots.narration: 受过培训的人，再按要求施救。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的移动登高平台
shots.scene: 实验室里一台带护栏的移动登高平台
shots.prompt_en: A mobile work platform with guardrails stands in a laboratory beside a tall instrument.
shots.narration: 实验室维护高处设备，常用移动平台。
overlay: 实验室里的移动登高平台

shots.section_title: 实验室里的移动登高平台
shots.scene: 平台脚轮被踩下锁死
shots.prompt_en: A foot presses down the brake on the wheel of the mobile platform. No people.
shots.narration: 使用前锁死脚轮，放在平整地面。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的移动登高平台
shots.scene: 平台上站着人还在推动，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person standing on a platform while it is pushed, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上面有人时，绝不能推动平台。

shots.section_title: 实验室里的移动登高平台
shots.scene: 平台上的工具放在工具袋里
shots.prompt_en: Tools kept in a tool bag clipped to the platform guardrail. No people.
shots.narration: 工具放进工具袋，防止掉落伤人。

shots.section_title: 仰头举臂作业防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 老李长时间仰头举手安装管道，颈部出现红点
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reaches overhead to install a duct for a long time; a red glow appears on his neck and shoulders.
shots.narration: 长时间仰头举臂，颈肩容易劳损。
overlay: 仰头举臂作业防颈肩劳损

shots.section_title: 仰头举臂作业防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 调高平台，让工作面靠近胸前
shots.prompt_en: The mobile platform is raised so that the duct is at chest height in front of the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 调整平台高度，让活儿在胸前做。

shots.section_title: 仰头举臂作业防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 老李放下手臂，转动肩颈休息
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lowers his arms and rolls his shoulders to rest.
shots.narration: 分段作业，定时放下手臂活动。

shots.section_title: 仰头举臂作业防颈肩劳损
shots.scene: 两人轮换作业的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two workers taking turns with a circular arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 重活累活，两人轮换着来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在挂着合格牌的脚手架前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a scaffold with a green inspection tag.
shots.narration: 验收挂牌再上架，上前自己查一遍。

shots.scene: 踏板、护栏、爬梯三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of planks, guardrails and an access ladder with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 踏板专用铺严实，走爬梯不攀支撑。

shots.scene: 安全带高挂在锚点上
shots.prompt_en: A harness lanyard anchored high to a strong anchor point. No people.
shots.narration: 坠落防护要到位，安全带高挂低用。

shots.scene: 断电图标和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: A power switch icon and a telephone icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 触电先断电，再打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣在平台下挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye standing beside a mobile platform with locked wheels.
shots.narration: 站得高，更要想得周全！
